Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API
Blocks.Text: Note

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API
Blocks.Text: The use of this API is restricted to those developers approved by LinkedIn and subject to applicable data restrictions in their agreements.

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API
Blocks.Text: Member Rich Content API is used indirectly through the Profile /me API and Compliance Events API to retrieve the current member's rich media content on their profile.

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API
Blocks.Text: Member Rich Content records are referenced in the profile as MemberRichContent URNs and appear in the following fields:

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API

Rows.Text: The list of memberRichContent URNs associated with the Profile summary. This is the Featured section. Default to empty array.
In education schema. The list of memberRichContent urns associated with the education. Default to empty array.
In position schema. The list of memberRichContent urns associated with the education. Default to empty array.

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API
Blocks.Text: Note

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content API
Blocks.Text: All API requests are represented in protocol 2.0.0. Therefore, all API requests require the header X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0

Blocks.Section: Member Rich Content Schema
SectionPath: Member Rich Content Schema

Rows.Text: The content of a MemberRichContent record.
Union of:IngestedContentUrn - Reference Links to web contentDigitalmediaAssetUrn - Reference Media upload photos, documents, and presentationsActivityUrn - Reference content Posts to LinkedIn
Values: IngestedContentUrn - Reference Links to web content
DigitalmediaAssetUrn - Reference Media upload photos, documents, and presentations
ActivityUrn - Reference content Posts to LinkedIn

Rows.Text: LinkedInArticleUrn - Reference Articles published on LinkedIn
A timestamp corresponding to the creation of this record.
A timestamp corresponding to the deletion of this record.
Customized description for the content if provided by the member.
Server generated identifier of the record.
A timestamp corresponding to the last modification of this record.
Customized title for the content if provided by the member.

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text: To gather a snapshot of the current member's rich contents on his or her profile, use the Profile API with decoration on the fields:

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text:
memberRichContents
educations.memberRichContents
positions.memberRichContents

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text: You can use the projection string:

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text: memberRichContents*~(content(asset~digitalmediaAsset:playableStreams,linkedinArticle~linkedInArticle:publishingV2,activity~activity:v2,ingestedContent),*)

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text: NOTE: IngestedContentUrn is currently not supported through Profile API. It is only available through the Compliance Events API.

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text: Below is an example:

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Profile API
Blocks.Text: https://api.linkedin.com/v2/me?projection=(memberRichContents*~(content(asset~digitalmediaAsset:playableStreams,linkedinArticle~linkedInArticle:publishingV2,activity~activity:v2,ingestedContent),*),positions*(memberRichContents*~(content(asset~digitalmediaAsset:playableStreams,linkedinArticle~linkedInArticle:publishingV2,activity~activity:v2,ingestedContent),*)),educations*(memberRichContents*~(content(asset~digitalmediaAsset:playableStreams,linkedinArticle~linkedInArticle:publishingV2,activity~activity:v2,ingestedContent),*)))

Blocks.Text: Tip: To decorate the domainEntity field in activityUrn such as shareUrn and ugcPostUrn, you can supply the projection string: activity~activity:v2(domainEntity~ugcPost~share:ugcPost~). Alternatively, you can make subsequent requests to the respective APIs that resolves each URN.

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text: Currently when a member manages his or her profile media content, it surfaces through MemberRichMedia events. With this migration, all profile media content management will appear as Profile events:

Blocks.Section: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Compliance Events API
SectionPath: Retrieve Member Rich Content via Compliance Events API
Blocks.Text:
resourceName = people or people/{sub-resourceName}
method = PARTIAL_UPDATE, CREATE, DELETE
